title: Did Not meet my expectations
text:
Did Not meet my expectations. This is made out of a cheap plastic. It feels more like a toy than a expensive paper towel holder. I was very disappointed with the lack of quality. Not a good value in my estimation.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
